prior_year_events.impact_description: Caused significant disruption to worldwide economies; ultimate losses subject to a high degree of uncertainty; Syndicate booked prudent reserves and a management margin.

named_events.loss_description: This conflict caused significant disruption to worldwide economies, both directly through the invasion and indirectly through economic sanctions being imposed on Russia by the UK, the EU and the US. Given the nature of the Russia/Ukraine Conflict, the ultimate losses relating to the event are subject to a high degree of uncertainty.

named_events.event_name: Hamas attacks on Israel / invasion of Gaza
named_events.loss_description: The uncertain global geopolitical landscape continues and has been exacerbated in 2023 by the Hamas attacks on Israel, the subsequent invasion of Gaza and the consequential ongoing effects this is having within the wider Middle East region.

data.standardized_narrative: Gross claims outstanding increased during 2023 with a gross prior-year strengthening of $95.571m (36.5% of opening gross reserves). The Syndicate attributes the movement to adverse development driven by mid-sized losses on Energy/Power and Cargo (Marine) lines, geopolitical uncertainty (notably the Russia/Ukraine conflict) and prudential margin/IBNR recalibration. Management booked a net margin and prudent reserves in response to the geopolitical uncertainty; reinsurance recoveries partially offset the gross strengthening.
raw_causal_phrases: The underwriting result was impacted by mid-sized losses on the Energy, Power and Cargo books.

In 2022 the market was impacted by the Russia/Ukraine conflict which is ongoing. This conflict caused significant disruption to worldwide economies, both directly through the invasion and indirectly through economic sanctions being imposed on Russia by the UK, the EU and the US.
A management margin of $38.7m net of reinsurance and reinstatement premiums has been made.
losses from major, natural catastrophes had little impact.

The uncertain global geopolitical landscape continues and has been exacerbated in 2023 by the Hamas attacks on Israel, the subsequent invasion of Gaza and the consequential ongoing effects this is having within the wider Middle East region.
data.data_quality_notes: All amounts taken from the syndicate annual report which presents figures in US Dollars and in $'000. Values in the JSON numeric fields represent millions of the report currency (USD). The opening reserves and prior year development were taken from the Technical Provisions reconciliation (Note 19) gross columns. exact_reserve_text was taken from the numeric table row since no standalone sentence described the gross prior-year movement. Causes and LOB-specific movements are partly inferred from management commentary (confidence <1.0). The field names use '_gbp_m' per schema but values are in USD millions (native currency).
